items.sentence: Today, the capable young sailor tied every knot without any help.
Today, wearing proper boots keeps your feet dry on muddy paths.
Today, frequent rain kept the garden green all through the summer.
One runny nose is one common symptom of a cold.
Scientists monitor turtle crossings and record the count each morning.
Today, growing puppies consume a lot of water every single day.
The small ant will struggle to carry the heavy crumb.
Today, daily swimming will strengthen the young otter's growing legs.
Blocks slide farther on smooth wood because friction is lower.
A young cook will slice the melon into ten sweet pieces.
